consumption.text: ~15 m bead | Nozzle diameter = 5 mm (~20 ml per linear meter)

compat.text: Application during high temperature changes is not recommended (movement during curing).
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Full surface applications / fixings are not recommended since the inner part of the adhesive layer may never cure.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not use on bituminous substrates, natural rubber, EPDM rubber or on any building materials which might leach oils, plasticisers or solvents that could degrade the adhesive.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not use on polyethylene (PE), polypropylene (PP), polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE / Teflon), and certain plasticised synthetic materials
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not use to seal joints in and around swimming pools.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not use for joints under water pressure or for permanent water immersion.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not use to seal glass or sanitary joints.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not use for trafficked floor joints
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not use for bonding glass if the bond line is exposed to sunlight.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not use for structural bonding.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

precautionary_statements.statement: Keep out of reach of children.
precautionary_statements.text: P102 Keep out of reach of children.

precautionary_statements.statement: Read carefully and follow all instructions.
precautionary_statements.text: P103 Read carefully and follow all instructions.
P261 Avoid breathing mist or vapours.

precautionary_statements.statement: Contaminated work clothing should not be allowed out of the workplace.
precautionary_statements.text: P272 Contaminated work clothing should not be allowed out of the workplace.

precautionary_statements.statement: IF ON SKIN: Wash with plenty of water.
precautionary_statements.text: P302 + P352 IF ON SKIN: Wash with plenty of water.

precautionary_statements.text: P333 + P313 If skin irritation or rash occurs: Get medical advice/ attention.

precautionary_statements.text: P362 + P364 Take off contaminated clothing and wash it before reuse.

precautionary_statements.text: P501 Dispose of contents/ container to an approved waste disposal plant.

storage.label: Conditions for safe storage
storage.text: Keep container tightly closed in a dry and well-ventilated place. Store in accordance with local regulations.

handling.label: Advice on protection against fire and explosion
handling.text: Normal measures for preventive fire protection.

handling.label: Advice on safe handling
handling.text: Avoid exceeding the given occupational exposure limits (see section 8). Do not get in eyes, on skin, or on clothing. For personal protection see section 8. Persons with a history of skin sensitisation problems or asthma, allergies, chronic or recurrent respiratory disease should not be employed in any process in which this mixture is being used. Smoking, eating and drinking should be prohibited in the application area. Follow standard hygiene measures when handling chemical products

handling.label: Hygiene measures
handling.text: Handle in accordance with good industrial hygiene and safety practice. When using do not eat or drink. When using do not smoke. Wash hands before breaks and at the end of workday.

respiratory.label: Respiratory protection
respiratory.text: No special measures required. Respirator selection must be based on known or anticipated exposure levels, the hazards of the product and the safe working limits of the selected respirator.

hands.label: Hand protection
hands.text: Chemical-resistant, impervious gloves complying with an approved standard should be worn at all times when handling chemical products if a risk assessment indicates this is necessary. Follow AS/NZS 1337.1 Recommended: Butyl rubber/nitrile rubber gloves. Contaminated gloves should be removed.

skin_body.label: Skin and body protection
skin_body.text: Protective clothing (e.g. safety shoes, long-sleeved working clothing, long trousers) Follow AS 2210:3

engineering_controls.label: Appropriate engineering controls
engineering_controls.text: Use adequate ventilation and/or engineering controls to prevent exposure to vapours.
